query: select n.nspname as schema_name, count(c.oid) filter (where c.relkind in ('r','p'))::int as table_count, count(c.oid) filter (where c.relkind in ('v','m'))::int as view_count, (select count(*)::int from pg_catalog.pg_proc p where p.pronamespace=n.oid) as function_count from pg_catalog.pg_namespace n left join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.relnamespace=n.oid where n.nspname in ('public','private','app_private','supabase_migrations') group by n.oid,n.nspname order by n.nspname;
